entries.headline: Bid Scanner tool, SB 1117 landing pages, AdSense reinforcement

AdSense reinforcement: google-adsense-account meta tag on every page, new Disclaimer page, footer cleanup. Fee-waiver cities post published and corrected after Oceanside's waiver wording was removed from the city's ADU page ('two confirmed $0s, one unconfirmed'). entries.headline: Correction: impact fees prorated to primary-dwelling size; Ontario areas no longer summed
entries.detail: Methodology correction, not a fee-schedule change. (1) Ontario: General City and Ontario Ranch are mutually exclusive area schedules (Res. 2025-010; Ontario Ranch DIF schedule eff. 7/1/2026) — a parcel pays one, not both. The old $96,171 cliff and $97,507 stack summed both areas at their full per-dwelling bases; both figures are withdrawn. At the 1,600 sq ft default primary, an 800 sq ft ADU now shows General City $18,798 + school $1,336 = $20,134, or Ontario Ranch $29,288 + school $1,336 = $30,624. The calculator has an area selector; jurisdiction and Fee Index pages show the range across areas. (2) Proration: cities that publish a per-dwelling base (not an ADU fee) now prorate as (ADU sq ft / primary sq ft) x base under Gov. Code §66311.5(c)(1)(B), with a new primary-dwelling input in the calculator (1,600 sq ft default, labeled as an assumption). El Monte's encoded $4,087 becomes base $10,217.26 (the $4,087 was the 800/2,000 example; at the default primary an 800 sq ft ADU pays $5,109; the SB 1117 note is recomputed to ~$319 at the same primary, and the Quimby exclusion is flagged unverified for 12/1 review). Lynwood's $2,756 becomes base $4,822.63 (the $2,756 was the 800/1,400 example; at the default primary an 800 sq ft ADU pays $2,411; two further schedule rows totaling $336.70 are under review for ADU applicability). Westminster is now min(prorated $17,179 base, $4,000 cap) instead of a flat $4,000. SB 1117 2027 conversions now cover dwelling-base lines too: ((sqft - 750) / primary) x base. Flat lines whose derivation is genuinely unpublished (including Hayward, a city-published ADU flat fee) stay marked 'conversion not published yet' and are never guessed. (3) Hayward park fee corrected $3,823 to $3,812 per the Adopted FY2025-26 Master Fee Schedule (eff. 7/1/2025); no FY2026-27 schedule was found as of 24 Oct 2026. Note: Fee Index figures previously shared with journalists used the old summed Ontario figures; they are corrected here and on the Fee Index page. Lines whose sources do not state a per-dwelling base are unchanged pending a second-phase source review.

entries.headline: New: SB 1117 permit-now-vs-January comparison in the calculator
entries.detail: The calculator now shows a 2027 preview alongside current impact fees: per-square-foot impact lines scale to the square footage above 750, and flat impact lines are marked where the city has not published a conversion. Only impact fees change; school fees, permit fees, and utility/capacity charges are unchanged, and the rule covers a homeowner's first two ADUs. A companion post draft covers the eight jurisdictions where January savings can be computed at 800 sq ft.

entries.headline: Correction: 750 sq ft boundary updated to current law (SB 543)
entries.detail: The homepage Hayward example and the 750 sq ft cliff post stated the pre-2026 rule (exempt under 750, charged at 750 and above). Current Gov. Code §66311.5(c)(1), as amended by SB 543 effective January 1, 2026, exempts ADUs of 750 square feet or less; the charge starts above 750. The calculator already applied the current rule, so no fee amounts changed: Hayward is $0 at 750 and $3,823 at 751, and the homepage now carries the through-December-31-2026 qualifier with the SB 1117 change noted. The homepage change log now shows headlines only, with detail on the full log page.
